description.en-US: Bede's exposition of the seven Catholic Epistles (James, 1-2 Peter, 1-3 John, Jude). Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A exposição de Beda às sete Epístolas Católicas (Tiago, 1-2 Pedro, 1-3 João, Judas).

sources.edition: Super epistolas Catholicas on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
